subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
3.  
A manufacturing company has set the standard cost for producing one 
unit of its product as follows: 
• 
Direct Material: 10 kg @ ` 5/kg 
• 
Direct Labour: 4 hours @ ` 20/hour 
• 
Variable Overhead: 4 hours @ ` 5/hour 
• 
Fixed Overhead: ` 10 per unit (based on normal output of 5,000 
units) 
 
During a particular month, the company produced 4,800 units. The 
actual results were: 
• 
Direct Material Used: 49,000 kg costing ` 2,45,000 

 
COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING 
 
 
7 
 
JANUARY 2026 EXAMINATION 
REVISION TEST PAPERS 
• 
Direct Labour: 19,200 hours costing ` 3,84,000 
• 
Variable Overhead Incurred: ` 95,000 
• 
Fixed Overhead Incurred: ` 52,000 
 
Based on this information, which of the following statements is most 
accurate? 
(A)  The material usage variance is ` 5,000 (Favourable) 
(B)  
The labour rate variance is ` 19,200 (Adverse) 
(C)  The labour rate variance is ` 19,200 (Favourable) 
(D)  The fixed overhead volume variance is ` 2,000 (Adverse)
suggested_answer: (D) The fixed overhead volume variance is ` 2,000 (Adverse) Material Usage Variance (MUV) = (Standard Quantity - Actual Quantity) × Standard Price = (48,000-49,000) × ` 5 = (-1,000) × ` 5 = ` 5,000 (Adverse) INTERMEDIATE EXAMINATION 28 REVISION TEST PAPERS JANUARY 2026 EXAMINATION Labour Rate Variance (LRV) = (Standard Rate - Actual Rate) × Actual Hours = (` 20 - ` 20) × 19,200 = ` 0 Fixed Overhead Volume Variance = (Actual Output – Budgeted Output) × Standard FOH rate per unit = (4,800 – 5,000) × ` 10 = ` 2,000 Adverse
